pkgmetadata.longdescription: Omarchy app reference: upstream omarchy-pkgs pkgbuilds/openai-codex-bin installs the vendor tarball; on Gentoo the same Codex CLI is packaged as dev-util/codex (::guru), which this metapackage pulls in. The upstream openai-codex-desktop Electron app has no Gentoo equivalent. Ships no content itself.
